description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for OpenMRS, extending SerializingCustomDatatype with serialization and deserialization methods for Strings. It is annotated as a Spring component, indicating it is used within the Spring framework for dependency injection.

classes.name: SpecifiedTextOptionsDatatype
classes.description: A Spring component that extends SerializingCustomDatatype to handle String datatype serialization and deserialization within OpenMRS.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts the String value into a form suitable for storage; here, it simply returns the input string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts the stored string back into the datatype; here, it simply returns the input string.
